title: The collapsibility conjecture for prism complexes of ample sets
statement:
Let $U$ be a Cartesian product and let $S\subseteq U$ be an ample set. Write $\operatorname{Box}(S)$ for the boxes associated with $S$, and let $||\operatorname{Box}(S)||$ denote their prism complex. **Collapsibility conjecture.** The prism complex

$$
||\operatorname{Box}(S)||
$$

of each ample set $S\subseteq U$ is collapsible. This strengthens the contractibility result proved in the paper; the conjecture is presented after noting that collapsibility is known for binary ample sets, while the general case remains unresolved.
source_name: Victor Chepoi and Matthew Maat, “Ample sets in Cartesian products”, arXiv:2607.04014 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04014

Status: **open** according to the source (as of July 2026). “This conjecture is open for subsets of Cartesian products.”
